title: Client
problem: A 2016 Ionic app where a critical booking journey took 12–20 s.
action: Led the migration to native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin); moved regression testing to Compose Testing + XCUITest.
story: My manager asked for a benchmark: the Ionic app against native. I ran it and presented the numbers. This simulation replays it.
Speed is only what a benchmark measures. Going native also put the app closer to the hardware, opening the door to wearables.

title: API Gateway
problem: High platform cost on CA API Gateway.

title: Services
problem: Legacy .NET/SOAP services with a large vulnerability surface.

title: Cache & Messaging
action: Message idempotency + Redis caching; reworked the architecture of a critical workflow.

title: Database
problem: Deadlocks and slow batches on high-volume data.
action: Tuned queries, transactions, locking strategy and stored procedures.
result: Batch 8 h → 2 h; deadlocks eliminated; +20 % throughput.

title: Quality, Observability & AI
problem: Production issues that span the app, chatbot and web; releases without a safety net.
action: End-to-end RCA with OpenSearch; Selenium / Postman / JMeter; BDD/TDD; 90 % Sonar gate; Copilot + Claude pilot.
